name: acar-grup-monorepo
description: Acar Grup Kurumsal Portföy Web Sitesi — 50 Yıllık Güven (İnşaat & Plastik Hammadde)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: npm --prefix server run build && concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,yellow" "node server/start.cjs" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
